reason: A dsh security utility that gates configured file-tool access to sensitive paths, masks recognized secret-shaped output, exposes metadata-only inspection tools, and records audit events.

summaries.zh: 用于 DeepSeek Harness 的安全插件，可按规则拦截敏感文件访问、遮盖工具结果中的疑似密钥内容，并提供元数据检查与审计记录功能。
summaries.en: A DeepSeek Harness security plugin that applies path-based controls to sensitive file access, masks suspected secrets in tool results, and provides metadata inspection and audit logging.

capabilities: Intercepts configured agent file-tool reads and writes based on path rules
Masks suspected secret-shaped text in post-execution tool results
Provides metadata-only inspection tools for protected files
Maintains a local append-only audit journal with rotation
Reloads configurable protection rules from a local file
